g.title: PD
g.text: set to 9 V (12 V not offered by every charger)

g.title: BUCK
g.text: set 5.0-5.1 V with no load; 1.5 A min
Bulk cap on OUT (220-470 uF). Star ground point.

g.title: NANO
g.text: Do not plug the Nano USB-C in while the buck feeds L13. Never connect L5/L6 (speaker amp).

g.title: RVLINK
g.text: rvlink SPI + DRQ (7.8 MHz, keep short, GND alongside)

g.title: PICOB
g.text: physical pin numbers (panel I/O in panel.yml)

g.title: FILT
g.text: 10 R series, 220 uF + 100 nF to GND

g.title: PCM
g.text: SCK to GND, FMT/FLT/DEMP low (H4L/H1L/H2L), XSMT high (H3L)
3.5 mm line out to the amp. Own ground wire back to the star point.

g.title: FTDI
g.text: GND/TX/RX only - never its VCC pin
